caption: A dry pine cone is tossed into a fireplace, and it catches, glows, and crumbles into embers.

sa.check: A pine cone is tossed into a fireplace.
The cone catches fire where it meets the flames.
The toss comes first and the catching follows.

pc.expect: The cone only chars, glows and crumbles and does not return to whole pale wood.
pc.fail: The cone turns back to pale unburnt wood; or the embers gather back into a whole cone; or the cone's scales close and lift again; or the burn front retreats leaving unburnt scales behind it.

pc.expect: The cone shrinks to embers and ash rather than vanishing at a stroke, and the fire's wood keeps its number.
pc.fail: The cone vanishes in a single frame while still whole; or a second cone appears in the air; or a log vanishes; or ash appears far from the cone with none falling there.

pc.expect: The cone falls downward into the fire, the flames climb upward around it and the embers settle in the grate.
pc.fail: The cone rises out of the fire and hangs; or the flames point downward into the ash; or embers lift and stay aloft; or the cone falls upward out of the grate.

pc.expect: The cone catches where it meets the flames and its scales darken and open there first.
pc.fail: The cone catches at a point no flame reached; or the cone rests in the flames and stays pale and closed to the end of the clip; or the flames pass through the cone and leave it untouched; or the cone glows while the flames are elsewhere in the grate.

pc.expect: The cone stays a pine cone as it chars and crumbles into pieces; it does not turn into another material.
pc.fail: The cone melts and drips; or the cone turns into another object; or the cone swells into a smooth ball; or the cone's scales fuse into one solid lump.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The fireplace's surround, the grate and the hearth stay the same.
pc.fail: The surround changes colour; or the grate changes shape; or items on the hearth rearrange.

note: Who tosses the cone is not judged.
